q: 1. Arrange the following stages in the enactment of government policy in proper order: I. Policy formulation II. Agenda setting III. Policy assessment IV. Policy adaptation
explain: The logical sequence starts with identifying the issue (Agenda setting), creating the plan (Formulation), adopting it formally (Adaptation), and finally assessing the results (Assessment).

q: 2. In what order do managers typically perform the managerial functions?
explain: The logical sequence begins with setting goals (Planning), then structuring resources (Organizing), executing the work (Directing), and monitoring (Controlling).

q: 3. The registration of the trade union of civil employees shall be made in the -------
options: Department of labour and employment promotion
Ministry of federal affairs and general administration
explain: The Department of Labour and Employment Promotion is responsible for the registration of civil employee trade unions.

q: 4. As per Protocol, who among the following ranks highest in the order of precedence?
options: Governor of a State within his province
explain: The Speaker of the House of Representatives ranks 5th, which is higher than a Deputy PM or State Governor in the general hierarchy.
